subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

judge.implied_focus: Themes in students' open-ended responses about their (likely remote/disrupted) learning experience -- i.e., the qualitative dimensions of instructional and experiential impact surfaced in the text.

per_column.name: instructional_quality
per_column.rationale: Codes a distinct theme (quality of teaching/adaptation) inferable from open text; a coherent facet of the learning-experience focus.

per_column.name: student_engagement_level
per_column.rationale: Captures an engagement theme, another experiential facet; ordinal scale gives useful granularity rather than restatement.

per_column.name: hands_on_loss_severity
per_column.rationale: Encodes a specific recurring theme (loss of hands-on/practical work) with severity gradations, clearly text-inferable and non-generic.

per_column.name: social_community_impact
per_column.rationale: Captures a social/community theme with both loss and strengthening outcomes; a coherent facet at good granularity.

per_column.name: unexpected_positive_outcome
per_column.rationale: Encodes an emergent-positive theme (innovation, confidence, new skills); complements the loss-oriented facets, adding structural balance.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively centre on one coherent focus: the substantive themes present in students' open responses about their learning experience. Each column is a distinct, text-inferable theme (instructional adaptation, engagement, hands-on loss, social/community effects, unexpected positives) rather than a mechanical text feature (no token counts or bare sentiment). The facets are well-differentiated and span both negative and positive dimensions, forming a sound thematic-coding structure at a useful granularity. The implied focus is genuinely actionable: an analyst can quantify theme prevalence, cross-tabulate with satisfaction/grade/subject, and target interventions. Minor deduction because the theme set leans toward a disruption/remote-learning narrative that is inferred rather than explicit, so coherence is strong but not maximal.
